title: Australian Vegetable Pie
description: A comforting, vegetarian pie filled with a variety of vegetables. This recipe is perfect for a chilly evening.
instructions: Roll out the pie crust and place it in a 9-inch pie dish.
In a large pan, heat 1 tablespoon of vegetable oil over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until softened, about 3-4 minutes.
Add the sliced mushrooms and cook until they release their liquid and start to brown, about 5 minutes.
Add the diced carrots and potatoes to the pan and cook for 5 minutes.
Add the sliced zucchini to the pan and cook for an additional 2-3 minutes.
Season the vegetable mixture with salt and pepper to taste.
Pour the vegetable mixture into the pie crust and brush the edges with the remaining 1 tablespoon of vegetable oil.
Roll out the remaining pie crust to fit the top of the pie and crimp the edges to seal.
Cut a few slits in the top of the pie to allow steam to escape.
Brush the top of the pie with a little bit of water and sprinkle with a pinch of salt.
